newsitem.title: USA: Williams says settles bank group debt.
newsitem.headline: Williams says settles bank group debt.

text.p: Williams Industries Inc said it has settled its bank group debt of about $8.5 million and its accompanying debt forgiveness of about $4.5 million and plans to apply for Nasdaq relisting.
Williams chairman Frank Williams said the company is now able to focus on its goals of continued profitability, long-term growth and the Nasdaq relisting.

The company was delisted without prejudice in May 1994 hen it fell below minimum exchange requirements during its downsizing. The company's downsizing took place between 1992 and 1995, a Williams spokeswoman said.
Williams Industries, headquartered in Falls Church, now has subsidiaries in Maryland and Virginia and employs about 600 people.
